name: codecaddie
description: Local-first business alignment for software systems

scripts.check: pnpm version:check && pnpm brand:check && node --test scripts/tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm reliability:check && pnpm evidence:check && pnpm recovery:check && ./scripts/check-public-safety.sh && pnpm audit --audit-level high && cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 >/dev/null && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && pnpm privacy:check && cargo test --workspace --locked && pnpm native:check
scripts.check:fast: pnpm version:check && pnpm brand:check && node --test scripts/tests/*.test.mjs && ./scripts/check-public-safety.sh && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.check:release: pnpm reliability:check && pnpm evidence:check && pnpm recovery:check && pnpm compatibility:check --require-clean
scripts.native:check: native check apps/desktop --strict && native test apps/desktop --yes
scripts.reliability:check: node scripts/check-reliability-gates.mjs && cargo test -p codecaddie-core --test performance_gate --locked
